Appraiser remarks
The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left tail lamp assembly is shattered, with the trunk lid showing a crease
that runs into the quarter panel. The pattern of crushed metal and displaced brackets lines up well with a straight-on rear impact,

repairs in those areas. The plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairing and refinishing the trunk lid, and a
pair of brackets, with labor hours that match the work involved. The invoice lines are single entries without repeated charges, and
I recommend approving the estimate as written.
